manifiesto.label: >> Our approach
manifiesto.p1muted: What do we invest in every day?
manifiesto.p1accent: Designing product and web that grows businesses — not just portfolios.
manifiesto.p2muted: No big agencies, no intermediaries. A small studio where every decision has a business reason behind it, not an internal validation meeting.
manifiesto.p3: Proving that good design can be measured.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.desc: We start with an alignment workshop mapping the business, users and real project goal. We define design KPIs, review the competitive landscape and establish which metrics will define success.
steps.desc2: Without this foundation, design is expensive decoration. Most failed projects share one thing: they started without understanding who they're talking to and why it would matter to them.

steps.title: Design
steps.desc: We build a component system from the first sprint. No paper wireframes — we go straight to high fidelity because real decisions happen when you see the real product, not an approximation.
steps.desc2: Every feedback round has an agenda and approval criteria. We iterate fast, document decisions and maintain the design system as the single source of truth for the development team.

steps.title: Build
steps.sublabel: From design to code, no losses
steps.desc: We develop in Next.js with Tailwind or deliver a production handoff with tokens, specs and exported assets ready for dev. The design is executed exactly as designed.
steps.desc2: We integrate Sanity as a headless CMS so the client can manage content without depending on a developer. Performance, accessibility and technical SEO are requirements, not extras.

steps.title: Deploy & iteration
steps.desc: Launch is not the end of the project — it's the start of the data phase. We configure analytics, define key events and set a post-launch review cycle.
steps.desc2: At 30, 60 and 90 days we review the metrics and adjust what the data indicates. The project ends when the numbers respond, not when the design is approved.

items.a: Nexxo is a studio that builds lead generation systems for startups using premium design, AI automation and CRO. We do not just deliver a website — we deliver an acquisition machine that works 24/7: an optimised landing page, AI workflows that nurture leads automatically, a connected CRM and analytics to measure every dollar invested.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Between 4 and 12 weeks depending on scope. A lead generation system with landing page and automation takes 4–6 weeks. A complete SaaS product (UX/UI plus development) takes 8–12 weeks. Always with weekly deliverables and direct communication.

items.q: How is Nexxo different from a traditional design agency?
items.a: Design agencies deliver files. Nexxo delivers measurable results. We combine high-fidelity design with AI automation and CRO from day one. Every project includes business KPIs defined upfront and a metrics review at 30, 60 and 90 days after launch.

items.q: Do you only work with companies in Colombia?
items.a: No. We work with startups across LatAm (Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia) and with international companies entering the Latin American market. All our projects are remote and we deliver in both Spanish and English.

items.q: What kind of AI automations do you implement?
items.a: We build workflows that include automatic lead follow-up over WhatsApp and email, AI chatbots for prospect qualification, CRM integrations (HubSpot, Notion, Airtable), nurturing pipelines with generative AI, and real-time analytics dashboards. All connected to your current stack.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: Projects start at $5,000 USD for conversion landing pages with basic automation. Complete lead generation systems with AI and product design range from $8,000 to $25,000 USD depending on scope. Use the estimator on our contact page to get a personalised quote in 2 minutes.

items.q: Can you work with my current tech stack?
items.a: Yes. We build mainly in Next.js, Tailwind and Sanity CMS, but we integrate with any stack: Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Make and AI tools such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini.

Every project includes documented weekly deliverables, unlimited revisions within the agreed scope, a complete handoff with source code or design files, 30 days of post-launch support, and a metrics review at 30 and 60 days.
